title: Gaps Between Research and Practice When Measuring Representational Harms Caused by LLM-Based Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on the measurement and evaluation of 'representational harms' (such as stereotyping, demeaning language, and social group erasure) in LLM-based systems. As these harms are central to the field of AI ethics, the paper's study of how practitioners navigate ethical measurement instruments makes it ethics-related.
